avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces amlodipine levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Potassium supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive hyperkalemia risk; amlodipine may increase potassium retention
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation unless prescribed by physician; monitor serum potassium

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase amlodipine levels minimally
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; limit intake if dizziness or edema develops

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.action: Use standard recommended doses; monitor for hypotension symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases amlodipine bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit entirely; effects can persist 24 hours after consumption

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.action: Maintain DASH diet principles; monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Licorice (high amounts)
caution_foods.mechanism: May cause sodium retention and potassium loss, reducing drug efficacy
caution_foods.action: Limit licorice-containing candies and supplements; monitor potassium levels

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure regularly as grapefruit can significantly increase amlodipine levels, increasing hypotension and peripheral edema risk. Periodic serum electrolytes (potassium) are recommended, especially if patient uses potassium-containing products or has renal impairment.
